lang_en:
There's a beach where the sea walks away, and four of us nearly picked Goa.
Ira wanted a party, so Goa was half booked when Kabir said wait.
He'd found one on NakshIQ where you walk up to five kilometres of seabed.
Goa would be packed, it said, and out there you might be alone.
That meant no shacks, no party, so Ira nearly said no.
Then she stood where the sea had been, heard only wind, and went quiet.
She walked out furthest, and for an hour Odisha's Chandipur felt like ours.
Travel intelligence is knowing what you give up, and going anyway.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
एक बीच है जहाँ समंदर पीछे चला जाता है, और हम चारों लगभग गोवा चुन चुके थे।
इरा को पार्टी चाहिए थी, तो गोवा की आधी बुकिंग हो चुकी थी, तभी कबीर बोला रुको।
NakshIQ पर उसे ऐसा बीच मिला, जहाँ पानी उतरे तो पाँच किलोमीटर तक अंदर पैदल जा सकते हो।
लिखा था गोवा में भीड़ मिलेगी, और वहाँ शायद तुम अकेले होगे।
मतलब न शैक, न पार्टी, तो इरा ने लगभग मना ही कर दिया था।
फिर वो वहाँ खड़ी हुई जहाँ समंदर था, बस हवा की आवाज़ थी, और वो चुप हो गई।
सबसे दूर तक वही गई, और कुछ देर के लिए ओडिशा का चांदीपुर बस हमारा था।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस है, पता हो कि क्या छोड़ रहे हो, और फिर भी चल पड़ो।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: There's a beach where *the sea walks away*, | and four of us *nearly picked Goa*.

cover_short: Goa, or the beach where|*the sea leaves?*

facts.quote: you might be the only person on the exposed seabed

shots: Late afternoon at low tide: a very wide shot of bare wet seabed stretching out to a thin line of sea at the horizon, no people.
Late afternoon in a small flat: four friends in their late 20s, two men and two women, sit on a sofa and the floor around one laptop, seen from behind, the screen turned away from camera.
Medium shot from the side in the same flat, late afternoon: one of the men raises a hand toward the laptop as the woman beside him stops typing, both faces turned away.
Wide shot from behind in late afternoon: one woman stands alone and still on the exposed wet seabed, wind moving her hair and scarf, the other three small and far behind her.
Close on her bare feet in rippled wet sand as a thin film of water slides past them, late afternoon light, no one else in frame.
Very wide in late afternoon: the four friends stand far out on the wet seabed, the woman furthest ahead, the sea a thin bright line beyond them, nobody else in frame.
